counterfactual_text: The sponge regains its original shape while the hand is still pressing it, and the hand lifts afterward.
positive_text: The hand compresses the sponge until visibly flattened, lifts away, and the same sponge then expands gradually toward its original shape.
semantic_text: A hand presses a dry sponge flat, then lifts away as the same sponge gradually regains its shape. Required visible entities: one hand; one dry sponge; flat support surface. At the beginning: sponge: dry, intact, uncompressed, and at its original thickness; hand: open, hovering above the sponge, and spatially separated. Required state changes: sponge thickness: original to flattened; hand contact: hovering to pressing to lifted; sponge shape: compressed to gradually recovered. These event variables are allowed to change: hand vertical position and contact state; sponge thickness and shape; sponge recovery progress. Preserve throughout: static side three-quarter camera; sponge identity, color, and dry material appearance; flat surface and background; one hand; one dry sponge; the same sponge and support surface.
